## 🧠 Multi-Tenant Qdrant RAG & AI Agent Engine
**Author:** Alfaz Mahmud Rizve ([whoisalfaz.me](https://whoisalfaz.me))
**Category:** AI / Vector Databases / RAG

### 💡 Problem & Solution
Enterprise RAG pipeline supporting multi-tenant vector searches. Isolates client datasets using payload metadata pre-filters (`tenant_id`), validates vector relevance via cosine similarity threshold, and synthesizes answers using GPT-4o with grounded citations.

### 🔑 Required Credentials & Setup
- **OpenAI API Key**: Used for `text-embedding-3-small` & GPT-4o synthesis
- **Qdrant URL & Key**: Self-hosted or cloud Qdrant cluster endpoint

### 1. Inbound Ingress & Tenant Auth
Receives user query and validates tenant authorization headers.

### 2. Embeddings & Quantized Vector Search
Generates 1536-dim embeddings and queries Qdrant with tenant payload filters.

### 3. Relevance Gate & Grounded Synthesis
Enforces cosine similarity threshold and synthesizes response with citations.
